name: Replication data for: The Genealogy of Law
description: This file contains all of the materials for replicating all of the analyses in the paper. It includes the raw data, the code for the estimator and sampler, and the supplemental data used in the analysis with code for replicating the analyses.
citation: Tom S. Clark; Benjamin Lauderdale, 2012, "Replication data for: The Genealogy of Law", https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/BISYEV, Harvard Dataverse, V2
